value.syntax: # [doc = " Positive finite resource ceilings declared before acquisition or connection."] # [doc = " (´def:wallet:rpc-limits´)"] # [derive (Clone , Copy , Debug)] pub struct RpcLimits { # [doc = " Complete outbound request, including authorization."] pub request_bytes : usize , # [doc = " Complete response headers."] pub header_bytes : usize , # [doc = " Response header fields."] pub header_count : usize , # [doc = " Encoded JSON response bytes."] pub response_bytes : usize , # [doc = " JSON nesting depth, counting the envelope."] pub json_depth : usize , # [doc = " Aggregate JSON values and object keys."] pub json_items : usize , # [doc = " Public decoded chain bytes."] pub chain_bytes : usize , # [doc = " One monotonic budget from cookie acquisition through typed decoding."] pub deadline : Duration , }
